text.en:
The provisions of Executive Order No. 955, series of 1984, as amended by Executive Order No. 988,
and the rules and regulations issued pursuant thereto, are hereby repealed.

This Executive Order shall take effect on January 1, 1986.
Done in the City of Manila, this 7th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
eighty-five.
